text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential: create a schedule, break large tasks into smaller steps, and set your own mini-deadlines. Prioritization matters too, so focus on the most important tasks first and avoid wasting time on unimportant details. Scope management helps you stay realistic, because trying to do too much often leads to stress and poor results. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early, explain the situation clearly, and suggest a solution. With these habits, you can meet deadlines more calmly and produce better work.
